Memory & Storage

ARIA’s memory systems for conversation history, vector storage, and document archiving.

Archive Index

Archive index for tracking processed and organized documents.

This module provides SQLite-based tracking of documents that have been processed, organized, and indexed into the vector store. It enables efficient searching and retrieval of archived documents by metadata.

Conversation Store

Async SQLite-based conversation storage for ARIA.

This module provides persistent storage for conversation history, sessions, messages, and tool calls using an async SQLite database.

class aria.memory.conversation.ConversationStore(db_path=None, auto_index_callback=None)[source]

Bases: object

Async SQLite-based conversation storage.

This class manages persistent storage of conversation history including sessions, messages, and tool calls. It provides async methods for CRUD operations and searching.

Usage:

store = ConversationStore() await store.initialize()

session = await store.create_session(“My Chat”) await store.add_message(session.id, “user”, “Hello!”)

Parameters:

  • db_path (Path | None)

  • auto_index_callback (Any | None)

__init__(db_path=None, auto_index_callback=None)[source]

Initialize the conversation store.

Parameters:

  • db_path (Path | None) – Path to SQLite database file. If None, uses config default.

  • auto_index_callback (Any | None) – Optional async callback for auto-indexing messages. Should accept (session_id, message) and return None.

async initialize()[source]

Create database and tables if they don’t exist.

This must be called before using the store. It creates the database file and applies the schema from schema.sql.

Raises:

DatabaseError – If database initialization fails

Return type:

None

  • error_message (str | None) – Error message if status is error

Returns:

The updated tool call

ToolCall

Raises:

  • ToolCallNotFoundError – If tool call doesn’t exist
